messages:
elena_csm: FYI — Ledger Inc. spend monitor just flagged an overnight surge on hosted API. Commit is $25k/mo, yesterday usage pushed projected month-end to ~$41k. :eyes:

mike_cs: Ugh. Any sign it's a burst of low-quality tokens (retries/loops) or an expected ramp?

elena_csm: Initial drilldown: 3 routes show >2x normal qps — chat-stream, embedding-batch, and a new rerank endpoint. Error rate is stable (~0.5%), latency slightly up for long sequences. Not a retry storm in logs.

finance-sam: Can you paste the projection calc? I want to confirm the math before contacting billing.

elena_csm: projection snippet: `projected_month = current_spend + (remaining_days * avg_daily_spend)` — avg_daily_spend over last 7 days = $1,300, prior baseline was ~$800/day. So 30d projection hits ~41k.

ravi_ops: Noted — I see a spike in embedding-batch calls from `ledger-recon` service around 03:10 UTC. 12k extra embedding units in one hour. Could be a backfill job.

mike_cs: @ravi_ops can you check request payloads? If it's a backfill we should surface to the customer and advise rate-limiting/queued batch.

ravi_ops: quick grep shows `job_id: recon-2026-03-20` in many requests, headers show user-agent `ledger-recon/1.2.0`. Looks intentional.

elena_csm: Reached out to Ledger PM (via email) asking if they scheduled a backfill. Also pinging their platform slack.

finance-sam: Action for us: (1) pause automated overage emails for 24h while we confirm. (2) offer guidance on burst shaping or Dedicated/Reserved commit options if this is recurring.

mike_cs: Agreed. Also add a short-term mitigation doc: suggest `concurrency_limit=4` and `batch_size=64` for embeddings to smooth spend. Can we draft and send?

elena_csm: I'll draft the note. If they confirm a one-off backfill, we'll recommend they run against Dedicated or use `rate_limit` in the SDK.

ravi_ops: I've set an alert rule to trigger if daily spend > $3k for 2 consecutive days, plus a specific monitor for embedding-unit jumps.

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice preview updated: projected hosted usage for Ledger Inc. increased by +64% vs commit. No charge applied until end of billing cycle.

mike_cs: Good. If Ledger confirms it's an unplanned job, offer a one-time credits conversation depending on cause. Keep CS-SAM looped.

elena_csm: Will do. Next steps: 1) wait for customer confirmation, 2) send best-practice note + suggested SDK config, 3) hold on auto-overage email for 24h. I’ll update thread with their reply. :+1:

mike_cs: Thanks — tagging @finance-sam for visibility. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
